content: {"summary":"Many users report that after signing out and back into their Apple ID, purchased songs and playlists disappear from their phone library while remaining on the computer, causing frustration with missing content [tk_87214]. Others struggle to download purchased tracks to their laptop, seeing only previews and no full downloads, and find the “check for downloads” function ineffective [tk_2285356]. A subset of customers experience abrupt music stops, ads, or lagging performance across the Music app and third‑party players, often linked to iOS 11 or lock‑screen controls [tk_2297634, tk_2631494]. Additionally, some complain that purchased holiday music is inaccessible, requiring re‑purchase, and that the cloud sync fails to restore downloaded songs after a restore or reinstall, leaving them unable to re‑download all tracks [tk_2590422, tk_491487]."}
